files.authorship: Independently written documentation of the RMS sections, commands, attributes, control terms, the rnd value form, the built-in name families, and editor snippets of the shipped behavior profiles. Behavior claims follow the project's own strict parser and exact generation engine; terms the engine does not model are described briefly from reviewed community documentation, chiefly Zetnus' Definitive Random Map Scripting Guide (the main community research source), in the project's own words.
files.license: Independent text under the repository license; command, constant, and label names are factual identifiers
files.transformation: No game file, official script, or community text is reproduced. Each entry records its evidence status (engine-verified, documented, or uncertain) and sources. The SHA-256 covers the file with LF line endings.
files.reviewer: Reviewed and approved by the project maintainer on 2026-10-04
